question: May a recording of a member or steward describing a claim be sent to an external speech service, on whose consent, under which processor agreement and in which region, is the recording or its transcript retained or discarded, who may transcribe, and is each transcription counted, limited and recorded?
decision: Speech transcription requires explicit speaker consent recorded on the case and a verified processor agreement, actual Azure service region and data-flow/residency validation; do not assert Canada Central processing without proof. Route through scanned/size-limited, rate-limited, audited intake, with a purpose-specific mandate and feature entitlement. Delete audio after successful transcription and retention checks, retaining only the transcript as a classified case record; no provider training on member content. Disable duplicate/unverified endpoint.
originalProposedDecision: Allowed only with the speaker's recorded consent, sent to Azure in the Canada Central region under Microsoft's DPA. Audio is deleted after transcription; the transcript joins the case record. Both routes apply rate limit, entitlement and audit; remove the uncalled Whisper route.
